scope: Theoretical extension requested by the user: exact/arbitrary-precision projections, roots, reciprocals, other mathematical functions and bounded recursive recompression. No production or corpus changes.
hypothesis: A reversible change of representation may expose a short description to a practical coder; infinite expansions alone do not establish a smaller complete representation.
finite_checks: Every 12-bit unsigned integer: floor square root without fractional information and exact square-root prefix q=floor(2^7*sqrt(X)); count outputs and invert through exact integer interval bounds.
Every 12-bit unsigned integer: floor cube root without fractional information and exact cube-root prefix q=floor(2^10*cuberoot(X)); count outputs and invert through exact integer interval bounds.
Integers 1 through 4095: reciprocal prefix q=floor(2^24/X); invert using exact rational inequalities, with a separately reported full-width [2048,4095] subset.
Perfect-square positive control over the entire 12-bit universe using tag+6-bit root vs tag+12-bit literal; account for all inputs. This is a mathematical witness, not a compressor comparison.
fixed_costs_and_limits: Input length, transform, precision and tag grammar are shared for each mathematical check. No claim of physical archive size or optimized prefix representation. Exact integer arithmetic only.
release_gate: Unchanged; no benchmark restart or reopening of closed numeric composition research.
